name: +1 Brainrot Every +1 Jump
desc:
Welcome to +1 Brainrot Every +1 Jump!

🏆 How to play:

Jump to increase your brainrot count!
🧬 Gain brainrot to unlock new Brainrot Characters!

Complete obstacles to collect wins!

Earn wins to increase your brainrot multiplier!

Use wins to upgrade your jump!

How much brainrot will you get?

✨Premium Players get a 20% Boost!
✨Invite friends for a 10% Boost per Friend in the server

Join our group to gain access to rewards, give suggestions, and or report bugs:
